newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong gold ends up on light physical buying.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong gold ends up on light physical buying.

text.p: Hong Kong spot gold closed slightly higher on Tuesday compared to its previous close on light physical demand in the region and from the Middle East, bullion dealers said.
Hong Kong bullion ended at $342.70/343.10 per ounce on Tuesday, against Monday's close of US$342.60/343.10.
The New York market was closed on Monday for a holiday. Gold closed at US$342.35/85 in New York on Friday.
"There are no sellers in the market, and physical (buying) and shortcovering pushed the market up," said one bullion dealer.
Traders reported good buying from the Middle East, with punters there expecting gold to hold above US$341, although some said physical demand had been average.
Other dealers said they expected selling pressure when New York opened later on Tuesday, but much depended on the dollar's stability.
Local gold ended HK$3 higher at HK$3,172 a tael.
